'''Courtani''' is a [[Seanchan]] [[Banner-General]].

==Appearance==
Mat thinks she is "as pretty as a bundle of sticks with armor bolted to it" and that she looks as if she "must have eaten something very sour once and — upon finding the resulting grimace useful for frightening away birds — had decided to adopt it permanently." He is not convinced she is is female, or even human.{{ref/book|14|28}} Mat's description should be taken with a pinch of salt.

== Activities ==
She is a [[Banner-General]] of the [[The Blood|High Blood]] in the Seanchan army in the [[Last Battle]]. When [[Mat Cauthon]] takes charge during the Last Battle, Courtani is slow to get him to the front; she is chastised by Empress [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag|Fortuona]] for this.{{ref/book|14|28}}

Courtani is part of a group including [[Lunal Galgan]], [[Min]], [[Selucia]], Tuon, Mat and over a hundred [[Deathwatch Guard]] that ride south toward the battlefield, along the banks of the river that was the western border of [[Kandor]] and [[Arafel]].{{ref/book|14|29}}{{ref|{{Twotc}} , Courtani}}

== Trivia ==
* Courtani is named for Courtney Gliszczynski, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
